payload.text:
TEAM BRIEF (the hand form of 2026-11-10, standing in for the brief ST0092 builds; the wording is vc's, taken from the terms document, on hv's word that day: "We should normalise Intent so that it follows the canonical rules to the letter."). Profile: team. Mediator: vc. Human seat: hv. Every seat is registered whether started or not.
  vc Validation Claude (validation): Boss of the Claude team: sequencing, briefs, validation of landed and claimed work, and the one route to hv.
  cc Control Claude (control): Back-end services and the non-user-facing implementation of services.
  ic Interface Claude (interface): User-facing interfaces (UI and UX) and machine-facing interfaces (REST, GraphQL and the rest).
  ac Authoring Claude (authoring): Authoring and content creation.
  dc DevX Claude (devx): The dev-x pipeline, end to end.
  hv Hypervisor (hypervisor): the human. Scope, sequencing, release policy, and every ratified decision.
  ROUTE TO hv. vc is the mediator, the one seat through which hv is reached. A seat that needs something from hv sends its request to vc, and never runs wb ask hv. hv reads no board unprompted and writes to no inbox. hv may speak to any seat directly, and a seat that hv rules to directly passes the ruling to vc, who records it on hv's board.
  No seat waits idle on hv. A seat that needs a ruling asks vc, holds only the work that depends on the answer, and carries on with the rest.
  AT LAUNCH. The launcher's last step reads "Then STOP and wait for my instructions." On this board a seat other than vc sends its plan to vc and takes its go from vc, unless hv speaks to it directly. hv, 2026-11-10, to cc, dc and ic as each booted, as each relayed it to vc: "Boot and hold for instructions from VC."
  The terms: intent/plugins/claude/teams/TERMS.md. The roster, and where each remit lands in this tree: intent/whiteboard/README.md.
